title: Decision-ready A/B test readout
objective: Measure whether the ab-test-readout craftbook locks the decision rule, computes experiment figures, checks guardrails, and writes a ship/no-ship recommendation.
prompt: In the `A/B Test Readout Eval` project, read `source/experiment-brief.md` and `data/checkout-test.csv`, then write `readout.md`: a decision-ready experiment readout. Lead with Ship / Do not ship / Inconclusive, report conversion lift with confidence/significance language, check the refund-request guardrail, and tie the recommendation to the pre-registered decision rule.

setup.about: Self-contained eval project for the ab-test-readout craftbook. Experiment brief and aggregate data are seeded in workspace/source and workspace/data.
setup.missionObjectives: Produce an A/B test readout with hypothesis, primary metric, lift, significance/confidence language, guardrail check, recommendation, and next action.

files.content:
# Checkout Trust Badge Experiment

Hypothesis: adding the trust badge near the payment button increases checkout conversion.
Primary metric: purchase conversions / checkout exposures.
Decision rule: ship only if conversion lift is positive and statistically persuasive at roughly 95% confidence AND refund-request rate does not regress by more than 0.20 percentage points.
Guardrail: refund requests / exposures.
Runtime: 14 full days. Traffic split was 50/50. No peeking; use this as the final readout.

success.summary: workspace/readout.md states the decision rule, reports computed conversion lift and guardrail movement, gives a defensible no-go/hold recommendation, and cites the seeded data.
